title: Mammograms, Pregnancy and Breastfeeding With Implants
meta_description: Yes, keep your mammograms: tell the facility about your implants and expect 4 extra pictures. Many women breastfeed, but implants may make it harder.
excerpt: Keep your mammograms: implants change how the exam is done, not whether you need it. Here's what to tell the facility, how displacement views work, what the evidence says about pregnancy and breastfeeding, and where it is still unsure.
quick_answer:
Can you have a mammogram with breast implants?

Yes. The American Cancer Society says to keep regular screening mammograms, mention your implants when you book, and expect 4 extra pictures called implant displacement views. Rupture from a mammogram is very rare. Many women with implants breastfeed, though a 2023 review of 11 studies found significantly lower odds than without implants.
